title: John Lear's 1977 lake-level photos of Groom Lake and the film swap

tellings.quote: original photographs from 1977 Groom Lake lake level with a chain going across.

plain: A man named John Lear is said to have had original photographs from 1977 of Groom Lake, the dry lakebed in Nevada better known as Area 51, the secret Air Force test site, taken from ground level and showing a chain stretched across the way in. The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell tells Michels about the pictures as Lear described them, and the story also involves the film being swapped, which the words given do not spell out. Pictures like that would be rare early views of a place the government kept hidden.
